convert_task_to_parlai_format: run parlai convert_data_to_parlai_format to dump a task dataset into standardized ParlAI text format
dump_data_function: run the dump_data function to convert task examples into a text file with labels and messages
setup_args_parser: use setup_args to create a ParlaiParser with num-examples, outfile, and ignore-fields arguments
convert_to_parlai_script: run the ConvertDataToParlaiFormat script registered as convert_to_parlai to export task data to a file
ignore_message_fields: use the ignore-fields argument to exclude specific fields like id from the converted message output
